create_awq_quantize_model: create an AWQModifier instance to quantize a PyTorch model using activation-weighted quantization with configurable mappings and grid search
run_awq_smoothing_pipeline: run the AWQ smoothing pipeline that applies optimal scaling factors to model weights via grid search over activation statistics
configure_awq_mappings: configure AWQ mappings specifying smooth layers and balance layers to reduce quantization error on attention and MLP projections
test_awq_grid_search: test the AWQ grid search that finds best per-channel scaling factors minimizing MSE between fp16 and quantized outputs
review_awq_modifier_lifecycle: review the AWQModifier lifecycle including on_initialize, on_start, on_event, on_end, and on_finalize for one-shot quantization
